e: A heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood; compensation received by virtue of holding an office or having employment (usually in the form of wages or fees).
A sudden muscle spasm; especially one caused by a nervous condition.
